tools.name: get_service_overview
tools.description: Use when someone asks what Private SuperIntelligence is, who runs it, who it serves, how to get access or what it costs. Returns the definition of private superintelligence, the service summary, availability, results and the six privacy layers.

tools.name: get_privacy_layers
tools.description: Use when someone asks how Private SuperIntelligence protects data. Returns the six privacy domains in order, from retention and deletion down to deployment.

tools.name: get_benchmarks
tools.description: Use when someone asks about accuracy, hallucination rates, cost or speed. Returns the published results with a link to the methodology.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search across every page on privatesuperintelligence.si, including the definition of private superintelligence, the privacy notice and the developer docs. Returns ranked passages with page URLs.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Returns the full markdown of one page. Use after search_site, or when you already know the page you need.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "register_interest" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Adds the person you are helping to the Private SuperIntelligence waitlist. Before calling, show them the exact email, job title and revenue band you will send a…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, register_interest · Private data: get_service_overview, get_privacy_layers, search_site, register_interest · Public sink: register_interest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, register_interest · Private data: get_service_overview, get_privacy_layers, search_site, register_interest · Public sink: register_interest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
